**Test Image Analysis:**
- Plant part: **Leaf** (close-up of tomato/pepper foliage)
- Key features:
  - Leaves show yellowing/chlorosis at margins
  - Mottled light and dark green areas visible across multiple leaves
  - Small pale/whitish spots scattered on some leaves
  - Leaves appear slightly distorted/puckered
  - Overall mosaic-like discoloration pattern

From the part index, leaf candidates in our 19 classes: Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato, Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato, Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus, Early_Blight, Gray_Mold, Late_Blight, Leaf_Mold, Phytophthora_Blight, Powdery_Mildew, Septoria_Leaf_Blotch, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus, Verticillium_Wilt.

The mosaic-like light/dark green patterning and leaf margin yellowing strongly suggests **Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus**. Let me confirm with one reference image.

**Comparison Analysis:**

The CMV reference (image 1568049) shows severely distorted, narrow shoestring-like leaves with mosaic pattern — this does NOT match the test image, which has broad, relatively normal-shaped leaves.

**Re-evaluating test image features:**
- Broad, normal-shaped leaves (not distorted like CMV)
- Small pale/whitish discrete spots scattered on leaf surface
- Yellowing/chlorosis at leaf margins
- No brown necrotic lesions with concentric rings (not Early Blight)
- No gray fuzzy spore masses (not Gray Mold)
- No water-soaked brown patches (not Late Blight)
- No white powdery coating (not advanced Powdery Mildew)

The pale yellowish discrete spots on upper leaf surface with margin yellowing most closely matches **Leaf_Mold** from the KB: *"Pale greenish-yellow spots on the upper leaf surface... Lesions appear as brighter yellow with indistinct chlorosis on upper leaf surface... spots typically less than 1/4 inch with no definite margins."*

CMV reference showed severe shoestring distortion not present here. No brown necrotic lesions, no gray spores, no powdery coating. Pale discrete spots with indistinct margins and margin yellowing best matches Leaf_Mold symptom description of pale greenish-yellow spots on upper leaf surface."}
